title: Implement precise real-time tab switching metrics display for system validation

requirements.text: Create a detailed real-time metrics display component that shows exact tab switching data including precise switch timestamps (with milliseconds), switch frequency (per minute and per hour), time away durations for each switch, current distraction score with calculation breakdown, and total switches count since session start

quotes: we need exact tab switching real time monitor result to make sure that everything is perfect

acceptanceCriteria: Display shows millisecond-precision timestamps for each tab switch event
Switch frequency metrics update in real-time showing switches per minute and per hour
Each switch event displays the exact duration user was away from the page
Distraction score calculation is visible with the formula breakdown showing how it increments
Total switch count displays cumulative switches since monitoring session began
All metrics update immediately when tab switching occurs without any delay

requirements.text: Update LiveMonitor component in frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx to include a dedicated 'Validation Metrics' section that displays the detailed real-time metrics component with all precise switching data visible simultaneously for system accuracy verification

quotes: we need exact tab switching real time monitor result to make sure that everything is perfect

acceptanceCriteria: LiveMonitor page includes a clearly labeled 'Validation Metrics' or 'Detailed Switching Data' section
Section displays all switching metrics in an easily readable format
Metrics are visible alongside existing monitoring displays
Layout allows for easy comparison between real-time activity and raw switching data

requirements.text: Enhance useFocusMonitor hook in frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts to expose a detailed switching history array containing the last 20 switch events with exact timestamps, away duration, and distraction score at time of switch for debugging and validation purposes

quotes: we need exact tab switching real time monitor result to make sure that everything is perfect

acceptanceCriteria: Hook maintains a rolling array of the last 20 switch events
Each event in history includes ISO timestamp with milliseconds, duration away, and distraction score snapshot
History array is accessible to components consuming the hook
History updates immediately when new switches occur

constraints: Do not modify the existing useFocusMonitor core tracking logic that uses Page Visibility API and focus/blur events
Do not change the backend recordFocusScore function or data schema
Maintain the existing 10-second backend transmission interval for focus monitoring data
nonGoals: Changing how tab switches are detected or tracked
Modifying the distraction score calculation algorithm
Adding new backend storage for switching history
Creating alerts or notifications based on the detailed metrics
